value.rationale: The last newly covered vertex is a natural network-exploration statistic. This complete all-positive-edge-weight classification recovers n-1 normalized resistances from n scalar endpoint measurements rather than trajectories, gives an exact feasibility test and noise-stability bound, and characterizes exactly when classical all-start uniform last coverage survives heterogeneity. The work is not valued for the standard gambler-ruin lemma alone.
